disposition_reason: Per-location means are shown only as bar charts (Figures 1-4), but the Results text prints the range of those means for each metal in sorghum and maize from Hawul and Bayo LGAs; those printed ranges are extracted.

study.design: Farm crop survey with health risk assessment
study.origin: agricultural locations in Hawul (Azare, Ghung, Thlila, Yimirshika, Pelachiroma, Shaffa) and Bayo (Balbiya, Bayo) LGAs, Borno State, Nigeria

period.as_reported: pre-harvest and post-harvest, three times a month for two years (years not stated)

study.method: AAS (Shimadzu AA-6800); digestion per Lawan et al. 2020

findings.group: Hawul LGA (Azare, Ghung, Thlila), pre- and post-harvest location means
findings.notes: Grain collected from agricultural locations in Bayo and Hawul local government areas, Borno State, Nigeria, pre-harvest (before planting) and post-harvest, three times a month over two years (years not stated). AAS (Shimadzu AA-6800); digestion described only by reference to the authors' earlier work. No LOD, CRM or recovery reported. Range is across the location means plotted in the figure, pre- and post-harvest combined, as printed in the text; per-location means are figure-only and not read. Basis not stated.
